note: MAU2-related CdLS is a newly recognized cohesinopathy with very few reported cases where postnatal growth restriction and microcephaly progression remain under active characterization.

evidence.text: GeneReviews notes that individuals with non-classical CdLS cohesin gene variants present with a lower frequency of postnatal growth restriction and microcephaly, while identifying MAU2 pathogenic variants as causing a distinct CdLS subtype.

evidence.text: A 2024 case report highlights that pathogenic loss-of-function variants in MAU2 cause CdLS, but emphasizes that very few MAU2-CdLS patients have been documented worldwide to date.

source.title: Clinical study and genetic analysis of Cornelia de Lange ...
source.quote: Recent research has reported that loss-of-function variants affecting MAU2, which encodes a regulator of the cohesin complex, can cause CdLS. Thus far, only one MAU2-CdLS case has been reported worldwide.
